note: No discount scheme is in force in Telangana. In January 2026 the Chief Minister ruled out challan discounts outright — 'not a single paisa should be reduced' — and proposed an auto-debit system for fines instead. A fake '80% off at the Lok Adalat' message keeps recirculating on WhatsApp, Instagram and YouTube; Hyderabad's police commissioner publicly called it fake in March 2026. The only genuine discount so far was the one-time December 2023 G.O. 659 window.

history.summary: One-time settlement under G.O. 659 dated 26 December 2023: two/three-wheelers and autos paid 20% (80% waived), cars/LMVs/HMVs paid 40% (60% waived), pushcarts and TSRTC drivers paid 10% (90% waived). Payment was made on the Telangana e-challan website during the window.
